mainEntity.name: What's the difference between group classes and one-on-one coaching for technique training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Group classes at Cave Training provide a supportive community environment where you can learn general technique principles and practice alongside peers. One-on-one coaching, however, offers highly individualized attention tailored specifically to your unique strengths, weaknesses, and goals. For complex issues or rapid improvement, one-on-one coaching allows for deeper analysis and immediate, focused adjustments, while group classes are great for consistent practice and learning common cues.
